chunks: From him, from 'Uthman ibn 'Isa, from سماعة, from Abu Basir, who said:

Recite on the night of Friday Surat al-Jumu'ah and Sabbih isma rabbika al-A'la; and in the dawn prayer, Surat al-Jumu'ah and Qul huwa Allahu Ahad; and in the Friday prayer, Surat al-Jumu'ah and al-Munafiqun.

key_terms.الْجُمُعَةَ: Surat al-Jumu'ah, prescribed here for recitation
key_terms.الْمُنَافِقِينَ: Surat al-Munafiqun, prescribed for recitation in the Friday prayer
key_terms.سَبِّحِ اسْمَ رَبِّكَ الْأَعْلَى: Surat al-A'la, designated for recitation on Friday night
key_terms.قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ: Surat al-Ikhlas, prescribed here for recitation in Fajr
key_terms.لَيْلَةِ الْجُمُعَةِ: the night preceding Friday, a time of special devotional practice

ai.seo_question: Which surahs are to be recited on Friday night, in Fajr, and in Jumu'ah prayer according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states the recommended recitations for the night of Friday, the dawn prayer, and the Friday prayer. It reflects the special status of Friday in worship and specifies particular surahs to be recited on that occasion.
